replication.target_description: Shrum et al. (2012), back versus front vowels, 4 × 4 SUV/hammer; Japanese online adult sample

n.sample_role: Participants in product-category subgroups; analytic n for this simple contrast is not explicitly printed
n.exclusions: Whole project excluded 247 participants failing IMC and ACQ. Reported simple-effect denominator df 821 is inconsistent with subgroup counts; no n inferred.

es.quote: In contrast, back vowel sounds were preferred over front vowel sounds for 4 × 4 vehicle and hammer (59.59–40.41%; F 1,821 = 70.981, p < 0.001, η 2 p = 0.149).

notes: Replication simple-effect dfs are printed as 1,821 despite category-specific sample counts; retained as printed. Original PDF is two-column text. The glyph b in pb.001 denotes less than; p < .001 is one-tailed. Analytic subgroup n is not explicitly printed.
